header: Short public posts, stored as text
lead: Three to eighteen cards, each a figure: the post in a blockquote, the handle and the origin in the caption. Cards keep their natural height, because a wall of unsolicited posts that all end level looks edited.
note: Nothing is embedded, so no third-party script runs and no consent prompt appears.

posts.quote_text: The post text goes in the quote field and is reproduced without quotation marks — an editor did not choose where it started.
posts.author: @the_first_card

posts.quote_text: The handle goes in the author field, the platform and date in the role field, and both sit above the words.
posts.author: @the_second_card

posts.quote_text: Three to eighteen posts across two, three or four columns.
